verdict.rationale: Loops documents event-triggered workflows that run automatically once set up: onboarding, activation, upgrade and winback sequences. Workflow graphs can be created and edited from code, and published workflows start when events arrive via the API, incoming webhooks or Zapier/Make. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run reliably unattended, and documentation of scheduled or time-based triggers and of monitoring background runs.
